case study · 04 / 05

Supply Chain Control Tower

An analytics project that turns operational data into an OTIF view for decisions.

ExcelSQLPower BIAnalytics

private repo　private repo

outcomes

OTIF delivery KPISQL data analysisPower BI visualisation

problem

Supply-chain performance is hard to inspect when source data and delivery measures are disconnected. The control tower frames the data around operational KPIs.

architecture

decisions · why · trade-offs

Center the analysis on OTIF.

The measure combines on-time and in-full delivery performance.

Trade-off accepted: A single KPI needs supporting breakdowns to explain misses.

Use SQL to structure the analysis.

Queryable transformations make the source logic inspectable.

Trade-off accepted: Data quality issues remain visible and need handling.

Present the output in Power BI.

A visual KPI layer helps compare operational patterns.

Trade-off accepted: The dashboard is only as reliable as its source data.

result

  • Structured a supply-chain KPI analysis around OTIF.
  • Built a Power BI view from Excel and SQL data.

if I kept going…

  • Add clear data-quality checks to the ingestion path.
  • Separate late and incomplete delivery drivers in the KPI breakdown.
